content: श्रावण {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) [श्रवण-अण्] .²1 Relating to the ear. .²2 Born under the asterism Śravaṇa. .²3 Enjoined in the Veda; विधिना श्रावणेनैव कुर्यात् कर्माण्यतन्द्रितः <ls>Mb. 12. 21. 16</ls>. .{@-णः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a lunar month (corresponding to July-August). .²2 A heretic. .²3 An impostor. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a Vaiśya ascetic unwittingly shot dead by king Daśaratha who was in consequence cursed by his old parents that he would die of broken-heart separated from his sons. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Causing to be heard. .²2 Knowledge derived from hearing.
श्रावणी .²1 The day of full moon in Śrāvaṇa. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of an annual ceremony performed on this day when the sacred thread is put on anew.
